title: Nonnegativity of the probability inner product
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. With $\langle f,g\rangle_\pi=\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)f(x)g(x)$, one has $0\leq\langle f,f\rangle_\pi$.
